agyos_skill.intent: Structured guide for setting up A/B tests with mandatory gates for hypothesis, metrics, and execution readiness.
agyos_skill.instructions: Ensure every A/B test is **valid, rigorous, and safe** before a single line of code is written. - Prevents "peeking" - Enforces statistical power - Blocks invalid hypotheses You must have: - A clear user problem - Access to an analytics source - Roughly estimated traffic volume A valid hypothesis includes: - Observation or evidence - Single, specific change - Directional expectation - Defined audience - Measurable success criteria Before designing variants or metrics, you MUST: - Present the **final hypothesis** - Specify: - Target audience - Primary metric - Expected direction of effect - Minimum Detectable Effect (MDE) Ask explicitly: > “Is this the final hypothesis we are committing to for this test?” **Do NOT proceed until confirmed.** Explicitly list assumptions about:
